screens.title: Momentum lab

conventions.browser_back: Choosing a lab tab pushes a history entry (/?lab=<lab>); Back returns to the previous lab with its inputs and result as the player left them, Forward re-opens it. Back from the first lab visited leaves Mechanica. "/" with no query opens the momentum lab. The page itself never intercepts Back.
conventions.keyboard_path: Tab order: "Skip to the lab controls" link → lab tabs (one tab stop; ←/→ move between labs, Home/End jump, Enter/Space or focus selects) → set-up fields in reading order, each number field then its slider → prediction field → Run → Play → Pause → Replay → Try another prediction. Enter in any field runs; Space toggles Play/Pause when a playback button has focus. Every focusable element shows a 3 px --color-focus ring offset 2 px (:focus-visible). The results region is aria-live="polite" so the score is announced.
conventions.hover: Hover only adds emphasis (tabs and buttons lighten, Run lifts 2 px, fields darken their border) over --duration-fast; nothing is reachable or shown only on hover.

screens.notes: Mockups: one file per state (mockups/momentum-lab.<state>.html) and the live 3D scene (mockups/momentum-lab.scene.html, three.js 0.160.0 from the pinned jsDelivr URL). Layout: header (compact logo mark + h1 "Mechanica", the three labs as a segmented tab bar); lab intro; the predict → run → compare stepper; below 720 px one column in reading order (set-up, prediction + Run, 3D scene + playback, Compare, explanation); from 720 px two columns 2fr/3fr (controls and prediction left; scene, results, explanation right), 5fr/7fr from 1100 px, content capped at 1200 px. Nothing is wider than 360 px at 360 px: fields wrap to one per row, the tab bar spans the width. State markers: the lab panel carries data-state = one of "predict", "compare", "no-collision", "input-error", "scene-unavailable", "startup-error", "token-undefined" (the running animation is data-state="run"); the stepper is an element with data-stepper and aria-current="step" on the current step; a missing token sets data-tokens="missing" on the panel. Inputs: each number field has a visible label naming its unit, a unit suffix, a slider bound to the same RANGES min/max/step (aria-labelledby the label) and a range hint; a value outside the range shows the RangeError message under its field and in a summary above Run, focus moves to the first bad field, nothing runs. Running: the stepper moves to Run, Run is disabled until the animation ends (or is paused), then Compare shows. Reduced motion: the run does not autoplay; the scene waits on Play with a hint, and every transition is removed. Scores: whole number, error to one decimal as a percentage ("—" when relativeError is null). Score bands for the verdict: 100–90 "Bullseye!", 89–60 "Close!", 59–1 "Getting there", 0 "Way off — try again". Bar colour: score-high ≥ 60, score-mid 1–59, score-low 0. The no-collision case (v₁ ≤ v₂) shows a callout and still scores v₂′ = v₂. Serving (for the Builder): each lab's address is "/?lab=<lab>" with <lab> one of momentum, friction, trajectory. server.mjs must answer a GET for "/" with public/index.html whatever the query string ("/", "/?lab=friction", "/?lab=anything&x=1" all get index.html, status 200); it decides by the path alone and ignores the query. The page then reads the lab from location.search: a missing or unknown lab value opens the momentum lab.
